## Introduction

Correlation between the HELIX [@vrijheid2014helix] postnatal (childhood) chemical exposures and
44 urinary metabolites, and lasso [@tibshirani1996lasso] / ridge [@hoerl1970ridge] / elastic-net [@zou2005elasticnet] regression of a
metabolite on the exposures with a grid search and subsampling stability.

## Setup

The analysis runs in Julia [@bezanson2017julia]; `ExposomicsJulia` provides the shared helpers and models, together with DataFrames.jl [@bouchetvalat2023dataframes], Convex.jl [@udell2014convex] and SCS [@odonoghue2016scs].

```{julia}
#| label: setup
using ExposomicsJulia
using DataFrames, Statistics, LinearAlgebra, Plots, StatsBase, Distances
using Convex, SCS
using Arrow
DATA = joinpath(pkgdir(ExposomicsJulia), ".data")
```

## Data

```{julia}
#| label: data
codebook  = DataFrame(Arrow.Table(joinpath(DATA, "helix", "codebook.arrow")));
met_urine = DataFrame(Arrow.Table(joinpath(DATA, "helix", "met_urine.arrow")));   # metabolites × samples
exposure  = DataFrame(Arrow.Table(joinpath(DATA, "helix", "exposome.arrow")));

tmp = filter([:period, :var_type, :domain, :period_postnatal, :family] => (x, y, z, w, p) ->
                 x == "Postnatal" && y == "numeric" && z != "Covariates" && z != "Phenotype" &&
                 (ismissing(w) || contains(w, "Year")) &&
                 !any(contains.(p, ["Traffic", "Social and economic capital", "Built environment",
                                    "Indoor air", "Lifestyle", "Natural Spaces"])),
             codebook);
var_name = vcat("ID", tmp.variable_name)
environmental = exposure[:, var_name];

met_urine = permutedims(met_urine, :feature, :ID)    # samples × metabolites
DT = innerjoin(environmental, met_urine, on = :ID);
```

Exposure × metabolite correlations:

```{julia}
#| label: data-2
M  = cor(Matrix{Float64}(DT[:, 2:end]))
ne = length(var_name) - 1
MC = M[1:ne, (ne + 1):(ne + 44)]
heatmap(MC, fc = cgrad(:plasma); yticks = (1:ne, tmp.labels), xrot = 90,
        xticks = (1:44, names(met_urine)[2:45]), size = (700, 500), tickfontsize = 6)
```

## Lasso / ridge / elastic net

$$\sum_{i=1}^{n} \left( y_i - \beta_0 - \sum_{j=1}^{p} \beta_j x_{ij} \right)^2 + \lambda||\beta||_2^2 + \nu ||\beta||_1$$

```{julia}
#| label: lasso-ridge-elastic-net
"""
    LassoEN(Y, X, γ, λ = 0)

Lasso (γ > 0, λ = 0), ridge (γ = 0, λ > 0) or elastic net (γ > 0, λ > 0).

- `Y::Vector`:   T-vector with the response (dependent) variable
- `X::VecOrMat`: T×K matrix of covariates (regressors)
- `γ::Number`:   penalty on sum(abs.(b))
- `λ::Number`:   penalty on sum(b.^2)
"""
function LassoEN(Y, X, γ, λ = 0)
    T, K = size(X, 1), size(X, 2)
    Q = X'X / T
    c = X'Y / T                       # c'b = Y'X*b
    b = Variable(K)
    L1 = quadform(b, Q)               # b'Q*b
    L2 = dot(c, b)                    # c'b
    L3 = norm(b, 1)                   # sum(|b|)
    L4 = sumsquares(b)                # sum(b^2)
    Sol = λ > 0 ? minimize(L1 - 2 * L2 + γ * L3 + λ * L4) :   # u'u/T + γ*sum(|b|) + λ*sum(b^2)
                  minimize(L1 - 2 * L2 + γ * L3)              # u'u/T + γ*sum(|b|)
    solve!(Sol, SCS.Optimizer; silent = true)
    return Sol.status == Convex.MOI.OPTIMAL ? vec(evaluate(b)) : fill(NaN, K)
end
```

Grid search over (γ, λ) for metabolite 25:

```{julia}
#| label: lasso-ridge-elastic-net-2
#| eval: false
Y = Array{Float64}(DT.metab_25)
X = Matrix{Float64}(DT[:, tmp.variable_name]);

γM = range(0.0; stop = 1.5, length = 30)
λM = range(0.0; stop = 3.5, length = 20)
grid = vec([(g, l) for g in γM, l in λM])
EN_opt = DataFrame(γ = first.(grid), λ = last.(grid), RMSE = NaN, MAE = NaN)
Threads.@threads for i in 1:nrow(EN_opt)
    sol = LassoEN(Y, X, EN_opt.γ[i], EN_opt.λ[i])
    EN_opt.RMSE[i] = sqrt(mean((Y - X * sol) .^ 2))
    EN_opt.MAE[i]  = mean(abs.(Y - X * sol))
end
EN_opt[EN_opt.MAE .== minimum(EN_opt.MAE), :]
```

Stability of the lasso coefficients over 5000 subsamples of 835 children:

```{julia}
#| label: lasso-ridge-elastic-net-3
#| eval: false
γ, λ = 0.052, 0
betas = fill(NaN, 5000, size(X, 2))
Threads.@threads for i in 1:5000
    sp = sample(1:size(X, 1), 835; replace = false)
    betas[i, :] = LassoEN(Y[sp], X[sp, :], γ, λ)
end
LR = DataFrame(Names = tmp.labels,
               q025   = [quantile(c, 0.025) for c in eachcol(betas)],
               median = [quantile(c, 0.5) for c in eachcol(betas)],
               q975   = [quantile(c, 0.975) for c in eachcol(betas)])
LR.Sig = credible_nonzero(LR.q025, LR.q975)
show(LR[LR.Sig, :])
```
